expectedOutcome: After completing the plan, learners can systematically solve array, linked-list, tree, graph, dynamic-programming, and design problems and maintain a complete interview review checklist.
goal: Complete a dense and comprehensive interview-preparation cycle in the official 150-topic order.
notRecommendedFor: One or two weeks to prepare.
There is no data structure at all.
All we need is a single subject.

phases.focus: Complete the official array and string core, emphasizing in-place modification, simulation, and boundary handling.
phases.title: Arrays and Strings

phases.focus: Practice state maintenance with two pointers, sliding windows, and two-dimensional matrices.
phases.title: Two Pointers, Sliding Windows, and Matrices

phases.focus: Cover high-frequency interview patterns for hash-map counting, interval operations, and stack structures.
phases.title: Hashing, Intervals, and Stacks

phases.focus: Systematically practice linked-list rewrites, cycles, copying, sorting, and cache design.
phases.title: Linked Lists

phases.focus: Practice recursive traversal, level-order traversal, and binary search tree operations.
phases.title: Binary Trees and Binary Search Trees

phases.focus: Practice graph construction, connectivity, shortest paths, and tries.
phases.title: Graphs and Tries

phases.focus: Practice decision-tree search, pruning, palindrome partitioning, and combination solutions.
phases.title: Backtracking and Divide and Conquer

phases.focus: Use Kadane's algorithm, boundary-aware binary search, and priority queues to solve high-frequency advanced problems.
phases.title: Kadane's Algorithm, Binary Search, and Heaps

phases.focus: Practice bit manipulation, number patterns, geometry, and simulation.
phases.title: Bit Manipulation and Mathematics

phases.focus: Complete the roadmap with multidimensional dynamic programming and a full-route review.
phases.title: Comprehensive Dynamic Programming Review

prerequisites: Understanding common data structure and complexity
A steady input of 10 hours or more per week.
recommendedFor: Wish to cover the official classic 150
There's a little brushing experience but there's no complete route.
summary: Use the official ten-week LeetCode Top Interview 150 roadmap to cover classic interview data structures and algorithms systematically.
targetAudience: Interview-focused learners who can sustain a regular practice schedule and want to follow the official Top Interview 150 roadmap.
title: LeetCode Top Interview 150 Plan
